receipts.reason: One test failed: tests/test_app_smoke.py::test_hide_menu_and_reload, whose app menu had a 'Recent messages' entry it doesn't expect (a bubble shown before the test hid the chatmon). The first run failed six others instead (W5-BEH-WSL-SUITE-LOADED). Each passed alone (wave5/suite-linux-failures-rerun.log, 6 of 6), and tests/test_app_smoke.py passed five runs in five on its own (wave5/smoke-wsl-5-runs.log, 97 passed each). In main's CI run 43778643147 the two smoke tests passed on all twelve test legs (and in the distro drill's two green runs), and the sway click test in the sway job; the compositor checks skip in CI, where KWin and Hyprland aren't installed. So the whole WSL suite has timing-sensitive smoke and compositor tests that fail now and then on WSL's /mnt/c tree; none is M3 behaviour, and M3's criteria are carried by W5-BEH-WSL-M3, W5-BEH-WSL-SWAY, the Windows suite, CI and the drills, which all pass. Next: the coordinator may make those tests' waits robust on a slow tree (reported, not changed here); then the whole WSL suite runs again.

receipts.reason: Five tests failed and one errored at setup: tests/test_sway.py::test_clicks_land_on_the_chatmon_and_pass_through_everywhere_else (setup: the probe said nothing in 30 s, its stack in shutil.which over a PATH of /mnt/c folders), tests/test_app_smoke.py::test_a_hook_reaches_it (the greeting still up when the hook's bubble came), and four of tests/test_compositors.py (KWin: the clipboard read empty in Chatmon's own window, and Orca's words included 'Ask Sparky'; Hyprland: a probe said nothing in 30 s, and the box wasn't yet an active window). receipts.method: main's CI run 43778643147 on 7816159, job sway (one of main's 19 required checks): a headless sway 1.9 of the tests' own on ubuntu-24.04, with CHATMON_SWAY=1 making a missing piece a failure, ran tests/test_sway.py and tests/test_wayland.py: 54 passed, 3 skipped. The overlay mapped as a layer surface sway draws and keeps out of its windows; clicks, the keyboard, the penguin's menu, the clipboard, full-screen windows, a screen going and drags all worked; buffers were the size of what is shown at 3840x2160 scale 2 and 2560x1440 scale 1.5; with a screen reader the ask box was a window sway floats, centres and focuses, and AT-SPI's registry found its field, buttons and conversation.
